request.style: English, acoustic, female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, hopeful and majestic mood, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Death entered through one man
Sorrow bound the world in chains
But hope was not in vain
A new dawn breaks the pain

[Chorus]
Christ has been raised from the dead
The firstfruits of those who slept
No longer lost in the dark
His power is not for the weak

[Verse]
As in Adam we all die
So in Christ we live again
The order is clear and true
From the dust to the sky

[Chorus]
Christ has been raised from the dead
The firstfruits of those who slept
No longer lost in the dark
His power is not for the weak

[Bridge]
Each in their own appointed time
The promise stands firm and strong
From the grave to the throne
A new life is sung along

[Chorus]
Christ has been raised from the dead
The firstfruits of those who slept
No longer lost in the dark
His power is not for the weak

[Outro]
All will be made alive
In the light of His way
